articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 Opus With Extended Reasoning and 2M Token Context
articles.summary: Anthropic has officially launched Claude 4 Opus, its most capable model to date, featuring a 2 million token context window and enhanced chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities. The model reportedly outperforms competitors on key benchmarks including MMLU, HumanEval, and a new agentic task suite. Anthropic claims the model introduces novel safety mitigations developed in collaboration with the UK and US AI Safety Institutes.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2.5 Achieves Near-Human Performance on Complex Scientific Tasks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind unveiled benchmark results for Gemini Ultra 2.5, showing near-human expert performance on graduate-level chemistry, biology, and physics problem sets. The model uses a new multimodal reasoning pipeline that integrates structured data, charts, and academic PDFs natively. Researchers highlighted its ability to propose and evaluate novel hypotheses in drug discovery workflows.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Operator Pro: Autonomous Agent Platform for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI has expanded its Operator product into a full enterprise platform called Operator Pro, enabling businesses to deploy multi-step autonomous agents across CRM, ERP, and cloud services. The platform includes a new sandboxed execution environment with audit logging and human-in-the-loop override controls. Early enterprise customers including Salesforce and SAP have begun integrating Operator Pro into production pipelines.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout Under Open License, Sparks Debate Over Safety Disclosures
articles.summary: Meta open-sourced Llama 4 Scout, a 70B parameter model optimized for retrieval-augmented generation and tool use, under its community license. The release has drawn criticism from AI safety researchers who argue Meta's published model card omits key red-teaming methodology details. Supporters counter that the release accelerates accessibility and independent safety research.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Compliance Warning to a US AI Firm
articles.summary: The European AI Office issued its first formal compliance warning under the EU AI Act to a major US-based AI provider over insufficient transparency documentation for a high-risk classification system used in hiring. The company has 60 days to submit revised conformity assessments or face fines of up to 3% of global annual revenue. The move signals the EU's intent to actively enforce the landmark regulation entering its second year.

articles.title: Microsoft Integrates RAG-Native Search Into Azure AI Foundry With Semantic Chunking Engine
articles.summary: Microsoft announced a new retrieval-augmented generation layer built directly into Azure AI Foundry, featuring a semantic chunking engine that dynamically segments documents based on conceptual boundaries rather than token limits. The update also includes hybrid dense-sparse retrieval with automatic query rewriting to improve recall on long-tail enterprise knowledge bases. The feature enters general availability for Azure enterprise subscribers starting July 14.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Finds Agentic AI Systems Causing Measurable Productivity Gains but New Risk Categories
articles.summary: A comprehensive study from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute tracked 47 enterprise deployments of agentic AI systems over 18 months, finding average productivity gains of 34% in knowledge work tasks. However, the report also identified emerging risk categories including cascading task errors, over-reliance on AI judgment in ambiguous situations, and accountability gaps when agents interact across organizational boundaries. Researchers recommend new audit standards tailored specifically to multi-agent pipeline deployments.

articles.title: Runway Gen-4 Turbo Enables Real-Time 4K Video Generation on Consumer GPUs
articles.summary: Runway has released Gen-4 Turbo, a distilled video generation model capable of producing 4K resolution clips in real time on RTX 5080-class consumer hardware. The model maintains temporal consistency and cinematic motion quality previously only achievable with cloud-side inference, according to Runway's published evaluations. Creative professionals and indie filmmakers are already sharing early results on social media, calling it a significant democratization of generative video tools.
